title_zh: 統合分析：抗抑鬱藥慢速減藥加心理支援，預防復發效果與繼續服藥相近（76 項 RCT）
title_en: Slow tapering plus therapy prevents antidepressant relapse network meta-analysis
summary_zh: The Lancet Psychiatry 系統性回顧與網絡統合分析，納入 76 項隨機對照試驗、17,379 名已緩解的抑鬱或焦慮成人（平均 45.2 歲、67.5% 女性、平均追蹤 45.9 週）。與突然停藥比較，預防復發較佳的策略：標準劑量繼續服藥加心理支援（RR 0.40，NNT 4.3）、標準劑量繼續服藥（RR 0.51，NNT 5.3）、慢速減藥（多於四週）加心理支援（RR 0.52，NNT 5.4）、減量繼續服藥（RR 0.62）；慢速減藥加心理支援的效果與繼續服藥相近，優於突然或快速停藥。慢速減藥單獨、快速減藥加支援、突然停藥加支援則無顯著差異；各策略耐受性相近；研究無資助。
summary_en: A Lancet Psychiatry systematic review and network meta-analysis pooled 76 randomised controlled trials with 17,379 adults with remitted depression or anxiety (mean age 45.2 years, 67.5% female, mean follow-up 45.9 weeks). Compared with abrupt discontinuation, relapse prevention was better with standard-dose continuation plus psychological support (RR 0.40, NNT 4.3), standard-dose continuation (RR 0.51, NNT 5.3), slow tapering (over 4 weeks) plus psychological support (RR 0.52, NNT 5.4) and reduced-dose continuation (RR 0.62). Slow tapering plus psychological support was as effective as continuation and superior to abrupt or fast tapering. Slow tapering alone, fast tapering plus support and abrupt stopping plus support showed no significant difference; tolerability was comparable across strategies; the study was unfunded.
evidence_note: 系統性回顧與網絡統合分析（The Lancet Psychiatry，2026 年 1 月號，13(1):24–36；2025-12-10 線上刊出；DOI: 10.1016/S2215-0366(25)00330-X；PMID: 41386898；經 PubMed 摘要核實）
caution: 60/76 項試驗研究抑鬱，焦慮證據較少，推論至焦慮需謹慎；平均追蹤不足一年，長期復發風險未知；樣本以白人為主（87.9%）；結果不等於鼓勵自行停藥，減藥須與處方醫生商議並有監察計劃。
brief_zh: 與突然停藥比較：標準劑量繼續＋心理支援 RR 0.40（95% CI 0.26–0.61；NNT 4.3；中度確定性）
標準劑量繼續服藥 RR 0.51（0.46–0.58；NNT 5.3；中度）；慢速減藥＋心理支援 RR 0.52（0.38–0.72；NNT 5.4；中度）
減量繼續服藥 RR 0.62（0.42–0.92；NNT 6.8；低度）；慢速減藥單獨 RR 0.81，無顯著差異
快速減藥＋支援、突然停藥＋支援亦無顯著差異；各策略耐受性相近；研究無資助、作者聲明無利益衝突
supervision_questions: 個案話想停抗抑鬱藥時，你會如何同佢同處方醫生一齊訂減藥與監察計劃？

posts.author_name: Zaccoletti 等（維羅納大學 WHO 合作中心）
posts.title: Comparison of antidepressant deprescribing strategies in individuals with clinically remitted depression: a systematic review and network meta-analysis (Lancet Psychiatry; DOI: 10.1016/S2215-0366(25)00330-X)
posts.content: PubMed 摘要：抗抑鬱藥減藥策略的系統性回顧與網絡統合分析，含各策略的相對風險與 NNT。

related.title_zh: 機器學習決策支援幫忙挑抗憂鬱劑：PETRUSHKA RCT 降低 8 週停藥
related.title_en: PETRUSHKA ML decision support for antidepressants RCT
related.summary_zh: Mental Elf 評析 Cipriani 等人 2026 年刊於 JAMA 的 PETRUSHKA 隨機對照試驗。這個決策支援工具以機器學習預測模型結合病人對副作用的偏好，在巴西、英國、加拿大 47 個據點納入 520 位重度憂鬱症患者（主要分析 493 人）；8 週停藥人數 41 對 69（RR=0.62），24 週停藥無明顯差異，但憂鬱與焦慮分數較低。
related.summary_en: The Mental Elf reviews Cipriani et al.'s 2026 JAMA RCT of PETRUSHKA, a decision-support tool combining machine-learning prediction models with patients' side-effect preferences. Across 47 sites in Brazil, the UK and Canada (520 eligible, 493 analysed), 8-week discontinuation was 41 vs 69 (RR=0.62); 24-week discontinuation did not clearly differ, though depression and anxiety scores were lower.

related.title_zh: 血液環狀 RNA CDR1as 或可預測 SSRI 治療反應（尚待獨立驗證）
related.title_en: CDR1as blood biomarker may predict SSRI response in depression
related.summary_zh: Molecular Psychiatry 研究分析 EMBARC 與 ANTARES 兩個臨床隊列的治療前血液樣本。對舍曲林（sertraline）無反應者的基線 CDR1as 水平，比有反應者高約 80%。CDR1as 可預測 SSRI 類藥物的反應與緩解，但不能預測安慰劑或安非他酮（bupropion）的效果。作者團隊包括開發此檢測的公司 Circular Genomics 成員。
related.summary_en: A Molecular Psychiatry study analysed pre-treatment blood samples from the EMBARC and ANTARES cohorts. Baseline CDR1as levels were about 80% higher in sertraline non-responders than responders. CDR1as predicted response and remission with SSRIs as a class, but not with placebo or bupropion. The author team includes members of Circular Genomics, the company developing the test.

related.title_zh: 統合分析：失眠認知行為治療（CBT-I）可降低自殺意念，長效證據未明
related.title_en: CBT-I meta-analysis: insomnia therapy reduces suicidal ideation
related.summary_zh: Nature Mental Health 的系統性回顧統合 19 項隨機對照試驗、4,974 名參加者。CBT-I 在治療後降低自殺意念，比值比（RoM）0.77（95% CI 0.66–0.90），證據確定性高。但 1–12 個月追蹤的組間差異不顯著；自殺行為事件極罕見，無法判斷對行為的效果。
related.summary_en: A Nature Mental Health systematic review pooled 19 RCTs with 4,974 participants. CBT-I reduced suicidal ideation post-treatment (ratio of means 0.77, 95% CI 0.66-0.90) with high-certainty evidence. Effects were not significant at 1-12 month follow-up, and suicidal behaviour was too rare (two attempts in CBT-I arms across nine trials, no deaths) to judge effects on behaviour.
